story.title: Institutional-grade procurement and quality gatekeeping from Indonesia to global markets.
story.body: CUAN-DONG Global Holdings connects international institutional buyers with verified Indonesian agricultural processors, cooperatives, and marine canneries through a structured, transparent procurement framework. Operating from Bintaro Jaya, South Tangerang, our trade desk manages end-to-end supplier compliance, laboratory specification control, unbranded white-label packaging, pre-shipment warehouse inspection, and complete export documentation (Batch COA, Phytosanitary, Fumigation, Health Certificates, and Bill of Lading) for seamless cross-border settlement.

highlights.title: Verified Direct-Origin Procurement
highlights.body: Direct allocation contracts with certified agricultural cooperatives, cocoa presses, oil expeller mills, and FDA/HACCP marine canneries across Indonesia.

highlights.title: Multi-Stage Quality & Lab Gatekeeping
highlights.body: Rigorous consolidation warehouse inspection prior to container stuffing—verifying moisture, volatile oil, fat purity, microbiological safety, and SGS/Sucofindo assay compliance.

highlights.title: 100% White-Label & Unbranded Export Packaging
highlights.body: All bulk jute bags, craft sacks, corrugated cartons, and OEM lithographed tins are supplied strictly unbranded or customized to buyer private-label specifications with zero third-party manufacturer marks.

highlights.title: Full Export Documentation & FCL Logistics
highlights.body: End-to-end administration of Certificates of Origin (Form D, E, AK, ICO), Phytosanitary, Halal BPJPH, HACCP, and FCL/LCL shipping from Tanjung Priok, Tanjung Perak, Makassar, and Bitung.
